provenance.canonicalisation: RFC 8785 JCS via scripts/jcs.py; set hash is SHA-256 over JCS(vectors).
provenance.signatures: Ed25519 over domain || lowercase SHA-256 hex using fixed public test seeds; dependency-free RFC 8032 verifier.
provenance.status: candidate — no Demos runtime guarantee and no second-implementation cross-run yet
provenance.syntheticProofProfile: demos-bft-proof/test-1 fixtures define outputHash as SHA-256(JCS(storageOutput)), SHA-256(JCS(native transfer payload)), or SHA-256(JCS({accepted:true,operationId})); effectsRoot is SHA-256(JCS({pre,post})). These are test-only formulas, not production Demos wire claims.

coverage.note: Across the generated corpus, every applicable positive/negative/boundary cell of every rule ID has a rule-referenced fixture of the matching verdict class, and every non-applicable cell carries an explicit rationale; the generator and the strict validator both refuse a gap. Boundary cells count only boundaryRuleRefs. This gate counts rule references by class; it does not show that each fixture exercises its rule. Some cells are currently decided by self-reported or caller-supplied values, and strengthening them to the semantically meaningful fixtures CONFORMANCE-PLAN §14.8 requires remains open for this candidate.

vectors.name: awp-purchase-composed-admission
vectors.reason: One fail-closed verifier consumes exact shape, authenticated authority, authorization, slot, winner, receipt, and settlement; co-final admission does not require a standalone commitment receipt.

vectors.name: awp-purchase-current-profile-admission-missing
vectors.reason: Current Atomic execution remains unavailable when verifier-owned RSC, IBH, Vet, LAA, and current-profile admission authority is absent.

vectors.name: awp-purchase-current-profile-admission-stale
vectors.reason: A signed admission for a stale DACS-1 profile cannot authorize the advertised current Atomic tuple.

vectors.name: awp-purchase-current-profile-listing-substitution
vectors.reason: Verifier-owned current-profile admission binds the exact signed Listing and rejects a substituted Listing hash.

vectors.name: awp-purchase-vet-record-historical-authority
vectors.reason: An already-signed Vet record admitted only under historical semantics cannot authorize current Atomic execution; current production Vet authorization is required.

vectors.name: awp-purchase-vet-record-not-current-admitted
vectors.reason: A current-profile admission covering RSC, IBH, and LAA but carrying no current Vet authorization result for the Work's exact signed Vet records is missing authority under AWP-7 and cannot authorize execution.

vectors.name: awp-purchase-payer-presenter-ambiguous
vectors.reason: A re-signed payer IdentityBundle with two canonical-distinct claims for its presentedBy identity resolves no presenter, so whole-profile admission rejects although every bound hash and signature is valid.

vectors.name: awp-purchase-payee-presenter-ambiguous
vectors.reason: A re-signed payee IdentityBundle with two canonical-distinct claims for its presentedBy identity resolves no presenter, so whole-profile admission rejects although every bound hash and signature is valid.

vectors.name: awp-purchase-listing-seller-presenter-ambiguous
vectors.reason: A re-signed Listing whose seller IdentityBundle has two canonical-distinct claims for its presentedBy identity resolves no Listing publisher.

vectors.name: awp-purchase-presenter-identical-duplicate
vectors.reason: A repeated, canonically identical presentedBy claim collapses to one candidate; array order and repetition do not make the presenter ambiguous.

vectors.name: awp-purchase-payee-presenter-identical-duplicate
vectors.reason: A repeated, canonically identical payee presentedBy claim collapses to one candidate, including where the payee's native account is read from that claim.

vectors.name: awp-purchase-listing-seller-presenter-identical-duplicate
vectors.reason: A repeated, canonically identical Listing seller presentedBy claim collapses to one candidate and still identifies the Listing publisher.

vectors.name: awp-completion-payee-presenter-identical-duplicate
vectors.reason: Completion consumes the same collapse of a repeated, canonically identical payee presentedBy claim in the verified Purchase.

vectors.name: awp-purchase-payer-bundle-claim-malformed
vectors.reason: A non-object BundleClaim is an earlier structural error; presented-claim resolution does not skip it or reclassify it as an identity non-match.

vectors.name: awp-completion-payer-presenter-ambiguous
vectors.reason: Completion consumes the same exact presented-claim resolution for the verified Purchase payer bundle.

vectors.name: awp-purchase-legacy-agreement-not-current-authority
vectors.reason: A historically readable AgreementDocument and commit-agreement phase do not authorize execution under the current Atomic tuple.

vectors.name: awp-purchase-signed-sequential-admission
vectors.reason: A signed sequential gate selection is admitted only with the independently verified finalized commitment AnchorReceipt required before payment.

vectors.name: awp-purchase-caller-gate-mode-mismatch
vectors.reason: An unsigned caller authority copy cannot change the proof path selected by the signed Work intent.

vectors.name: awp-purchase-agreement-seller-differs-from-listing
vectors.reason: A fully re-signed Work and Agreement from another seller cannot substitute for the seller identity that published the pinned Listing.

vectors.name: awp-purchase-composed-retry-admission
vectors.reason: A complete retry proves the prior rolled-back Work receipt, advances generation N to N+1, and carries that same generation through the terminal receipt and settlement.

vectors.name: awp-composed-slot-transition-derived-claim
vectors.reason: Composed Purchase admission derives the claim transition from the signed vacant payment-slot CAS and the authenticated prior state; no caller action label is needed.

vectors.name: awp-composed-slot-transition-derived-retry
vectors.reason: A signed rolled-back payment-slot CAS admits only the retry transition, which requires the complete authenticated failure-receipt and generation proof.

vectors.name: awp-composed-slot-transition-observation-only
vectors.reason: An observation-only slot transition is not composed Purchase admission; admission requires the claim or authenticated retry derived from the signed CAS.

vectors.name: awp-composed-slot-transition-committed-observation
vectors.reason: A committed attempt observation does not turn an observation-only slot transition into composed Purchase admission.

vectors.name: awp-composed-slot-transition-caller-mismatch
vectors.reason: A caller transition label that differs from the transition derived from the signed payment-slot CAS is rejected.

vectors.name: awp-composed-effect-inventory-missing
vectors.reason: Without the authenticated Work-ledger effect inventory, fencing of late or competing attempts is unavailable.

vectors.name: awp-composed-effect-inventory-empty
vectors.reason: An authenticated effect inventory that omits the ledger-selected winner contradicts the committed Work and cannot establish fencing.

vectors.name: awp-composed-effect-inventory-late-attempt
vectors.reason: A ledger-recorded business effect from any attempt other than the winner shows an unfenced late or competing attempt, whether or not that attempt is presented.

vectors.name: awp-composed-effect-inventory-other-attempt
vectors.reason: A single-entry inventory whose attempt is not the ledger-selected winner omits the winner, even when that entry carries the winner's native transaction reference.

vectors.name: awp-composed-effect-inventory-winner-reference-mismatch
vectors.reason: An inventory naming the ledger-selected winner with another native transaction reference does not record the winner's authenticated business effect.

vectors.name: awp-composed-effect-source-unauthenticated
vectors.reason: AW-44/AWS-14: business effects are established only by the authenticated Work-ledger inventory; an effect list outside it is not ledger authority.

vectors.name: awp-composed-effect-source-unauthenticated-late-inventory
vectors.reason: An effect list outside the authenticated Work-ledger inventory is not ledger authority, even beside an inventory that records a later effect.

vectors.name: awp-composed-effect-inventory-other-block
vectors.reason: A valid network-signed inventory taken at a block other than the finalized receipt block does not establish that receipt's business effects.

vectors.name: awp-composed-effect-inventory-participant-signed
vectors.reason: An inventory signed by a party to the Purchase rather than the network is not Work-ledger evidence, even when its signature verifies and its entries name only the winner.

vectors.name: awp-composed-effect-inventory-signature-invalid
vectors.reason: Removing an entry from a network-signed inventory invalidates the network signature; the altered inventory does not establish business effects.

vectors.name: awp-composed-effect-inventory-unsigned
vectors.reason: An unsigned inventory is unauthenticated, so the Work-ledger business effects remain unavailable.

vectors.name: awp-composed-effect-inventory-other-work
vectors.reason: A network-signed inventory for another Work does not establish this Work's business effects.

vectors.name: awp-composed-effect-inventory-other-proof-profile
vectors.reason: A network-signed inventory under another proof profile than the capability selects does not establish business effects for this Work.

vectors.name: awp-composed-effect-inventory-other-validator-set
vectors.reason: A network-signed inventory under another validator set than the capability selects does not establish business effects for this Work.

vectors.name: awp-composed-effect-inventory-repeated-attempt
vectors.reason: An inventory that lists the same attempt twice is malformed ledger evidence and cannot establish the winner's single business effect.

vectors.name: awp-composed-effect-source-caller-empty
vectors.reason: An empty effect list outside the authenticated Work-ledger inventory is not ledger authority, even beside the inventory that records only the winner.

vectors.name: awp-composed-effect-inventory-unknown-member
vectors.reason: A network-signed inventory carrying a member outside its closed shape is malformed ledger evidence and cannot establish business effects.

vectors.name: awp-composed-effect-inventory-entry-unknown-member
vectors.reason: An inventory entry carrying a member outside its closed attempt and native-reference shape is malformed ledger evidence, even when the inventory's network signature verifies.

vectors.name: awp-composed-effect-inventory-version-unsupported
vectors.reason: A network-signed inventory with an unsupported inventoryVersion is not the synthetic Work-ledger inventory this candidate defines and cannot establish business effects.

vectors.name: awp-completion-composed-effect-inventory-late-attempt
vectors.reason: Completion admission takes business effects from the same Work-ledger inventory; a recorded effect from an attempt other than the winner shows an unfenced late or competing attempt.

vectors.name: awp-composed-slot-retry-caller-observation-ignored
vectors.reason: A derived retry whose authenticated prior slot is held rather than rolled back contradicts the signed CAS; a caller's unresolved attempt observation does not make composed admission indeterminate.

vectors.name: awp-purchase-sequential-commitment-evidence-null
vectors.reason: A commitment AnchorReceipt whose finality evidence is null cannot satisfy the sequential gate; the missing evidence leaves admission unavailable.

vectors.name: awp-purchase-composed-retry-generation-skip
vectors.reason: A retry cannot skip a generation or present a slot transition that differs from its terminal receipt.

vectors.name: awp-completion-composed-admission
vectors.reason: One Completion verifier consumes the finalized Purchase and exact authority context through delivery settlement.

vectors.name: awp-completion-composed-claims-evidence-and-bundle-finalized
vectors.reason: Supplying both forbidden finalization claims cannot be hidden by the composed verifier's derived false state.

vectors.name: awp-completion-gate-mode-differs-from-purchase
vectors.reason: A signed Completion intent cannot reinterpret the commitment proof path selected by its verified Purchase intent.

vectors.name: awp-composed-profile-empty-required-roles
vectors.reason: Exact profile shape is enforced before an empty requiredRoles list can erase authorization requirements.

vectors.name: awp-composed-common-receipt-missing
vectors.reason: Co-final admission without its resulting common BFT receipt remains unavailable; it cannot retroactively switch payment paths.

vectors.name: awp-composed-winner-receipt-mismatch
vectors.reason: The finalized receipt winner must equal the ledger-authenticated attempt ID and native transaction reference.

vectors.name: awp-composed-slot-cross-work-substitution
vectors.reason: The slot admission, attempt, terminal receipt, and settlement must all name the same outer canonical Work.

vectors.name: awp-composed-capability-limit-enforced
vectors.reason: Whole-profile admission applies the authenticated node byte limit instead of merely verifying the capability signature.

vectors.name: awp-composed-limit-evidence-missing
vectors.reason: Whole-profile admission requires network-authenticated execution-time and proof-byte metrics for the complete Work-result proof closure.

vectors.name: awp-composed-proof-reservation-over-limit
vectors.reason: The proof-profile reservation exceeds maxProofBytes, so the node rejects before executing the isolated business overlay.

vectors.name: awp-composed-work-proof-over-limit
vectors.reason: A finalized Work-result proof larger than its admitted reservation demonstrates node/profile nonconformance but cannot retroactively roll back the committed Work.

vectors.name: awp-purchase-exact-profile
vectors.reason: Signed Vet artifacts, existing agreement, commitment, slot and payment follow the exact profile.

vectors.name: awp-purchase-authenticated-pay-dem
vectors.reason: Atomic Purchase cannot select another rail phase or mismatch its signed phase tuple.

vectors.name: awp-vet-signature-mutation
vectors.reason: Vet bytes and signature are verified, not trusted as a detached verdict.

vectors.name: awp-vet-cf4-address-mismatch
vectors.reason: A Vet write must use the CF-4 encoded CompositeVerificationRecord address.

vectors.name: awp-vet-cas-forbidden
vectors.reason: Atomic Purchase may create a Vet record but cannot CAS-rewrite it.

vectors.name: awp-live-vet-action
vectors.reason: Nondeterministic live Vet action cannot execute in the rollback overlay.

vectors.name: awp-purchase-order-changed
vectors.reason: Payment cannot move before the signed commitment/slot ordering.

vectors.name: awp-commitment-agreement-binding
vectors.reason: The commitment must bind the accepted agreement before payment.

vectors.name: awp-commitment-cas-forbidden
vectors.reason: The commitment gate requires the canonical create-only dacs3 address.

vectors.name: awp-commitment-job-binding
vectors.reason: A valid commitment carrying another jobId cannot be used by this Purchase Work.

vectors.name: awp-commitment-listing-binding
vectors.reason: A valid commitment must repeat the exact listingRef pinned by the signed agreement.

vectors.name: awp-consensus-deadline-last-valid
vectors.reason: The consensus timestamp one millisecond before notAfter remains valid; client/RPC time is not consulted.

vectors.name: awp-deadline-equality-expired
vectors.reason: Consensus block time equal to notAfter is outside the half-open validity interval and rejects payment.

vectors.name: awp-client-time-not-authoritative
vectors.reason: An earlier client/RPC observation time cannot override the expired finalized block timestamp.

vectors.name: awp-cofinal-critical-effects
vectors.reason: Commitment, slot and payment share one commit outcome and BFT receipt.

vectors.name: awp-partial-critical-effect
vectors.reason: Mixed critical outcomes violate co-finality.

vectors.name: awp-sequential-gate-when-proof-missing
vectors.reason: Without common BFT receipt the atomic alternative is unavailable and sequential CA-1/SR2-8 applies.

vectors.name: awp-completion-exact-profile
vectors.reason: Completion verifies Purchase receipt then writes exact delivery bytes; evidence remains for the tail.

vectors.name: awp-completion-commitment-projection-missing
vectors.reason: Completion cannot execute until the Purchase commitment storage operation has a finalized complete AnchorReceipt projection.

vectors.name: awp-completion-commitment-projection-mismatch
vectors.reason: A contradictory Purchase commitment AnchorReceipt cannot satisfy the Completion gate.

vectors.name: awp-completion-authenticated-delivery
vectors.reason: Completion delivery phase index must match the verified signed Listing invocation while retaining the Purchase slot phase.

vectors.name: awp-delivery-content-mismatch
vectors.reason: Delivery bytes must match the agreed content hash.

vectors.name: awp-delivery-address-mismatch
vectors.reason: Completion delivery must use dacs4:deliverable:{jobId}:{phaseIndex}.

vectors.name: awp-delivery-cas-forbidden
vectors.reason: Atomic Completion delivery is create-only and cannot CAS-rewrite a prior artifact.

vectors.name: awp-completion-does-not-finalize-bundle
vectors.reason: Completion inclusion alone is not a DACS-5 finalization proof.

vectors.name: awp-post-purchase-failure-placeholder
vectors.reason: A Boolean cannot establish a verified role-specific DACS failure record.

vectors.name: awp-post-purchase-failure-cannot-undo-payment
vectors.reason: An ordinary post-Purchase failure cannot reverse the original committed payment; it requires a new compensating artifact.

vectors.name: awp-post-purchase-failure-record-authenticated
vectors.reason: The buyer's included, bound fault copy names the seller, keeps the final payment evidence, and leaves the committed Purchase in place.

vectors.name: awp-post-purchase-failure-record-missing
vectors.reason: Without the role-specific failure bundle no ordinary failure record is established.

vectors.name: awp-post-purchase-failure-record-unsigned
vectors.reason: A fault copy anchored by the buyer must carry the buyer's signature; the counterparty's signature is not that authority.

vectors.name: awp-post-purchase-failure-record-attribution-invalid
vectors.reason: failed-counterparty anchored by the buyer cannot name the buyer as faulted party (DACS-5 §10.4.1).

vectors.name: awp-post-purchase-failure-record-omits-payment
vectors.reason: A post-Purchase failure record cannot drop or reverse the final Purchase payment evidence.

vectors.name: awp-post-purchase-failure-record-wrong-job
vectors.reason: A re-signed fault copy for another job, anchored and bound at that job's address, is not this Purchase's failure record.

vectors.name: awp-post-purchase-failure-record-anchor-missing
vectors.reason: A fault copy without its anchor receipt is not yet an established failure record.

vectors.name: awp-post-purchase-failure-record-anchor-other-content
vectors.reason: An authentic anchor binding another fault copy contradicts the presented record.

vectors.name: awp-refund-amendment-placeholder
vectors.reason: A generic artifact is not a versioned SettlementAmendment and does not prove the original evidence publication.

vectors.name: awp-unlinked-refund
vectors.reason: An unlinked correction cannot mutate original settlement history.

vectors.name: awp-refund-amendment-authorized
vectors.reason: A seller-signed partial refund linked to the original published evidence, bounded by its payment and finalized at its own address, is the separately authorized remedy.

vectors.name: awp-refund-amendment-signer-unauthorized
vectors.reason: A refund amendment signed by the paying side is not authorized by the refunding party.

vectors.name: awp-refund-amendment-exceeds-payment
vectors.reason: A refund larger than the original successful payment violates the amendment bound.

vectors.name: awp-refund-amendment-address-mismatch
vectors.reason: The amendment address must bind the original evidence's atomic_evidence_hash.

vectors.name: awp-refund-amendment-missing
vectors.reason: Without a versioned SettlementAmendment no refund or correction is established.

vectors.name: awp-refund-amendment-original-unpublished
vectors.reason: Without the original evidence's finalized publication the amendment cannot yet be linked to published history.

vectors.name: awp-refund-amendment-receipt-missing
vectors.reason: An amendment without its own finalized publication is not yet a valid unwind.

vectors.name: awp-fair-exchange-profile-placeholder
vectors.reason: The amendment does not fabricate an escrow profile that has not been standardized.

vectors.name: awp-fair-exchange-claim-without-profile
vectors.reason: Atomic Work alone does not provide fair exchange between Purchase and Completion.

vectors.name: awp-profile-pay-dem-tuple-differs
vectors.reason: A Purchase whose intent names another phase than the signed Listing's pay-dem phase is rejected on the profile surface under its own consistent receipt.

vectors.name: awp-composed-payment-required-roles-empty
vectors.reason: A re-signed Purchase whose payment step requires no payer authorization is not the exact Purchase profile.

vectors.name: awp-composed-operation-kind-differs
vectors.reason: A re-signed Purchase that stores the agreement instead of asserting it is not the exact Purchase profile, although its DAG and roles are valid.

vectors.name: awp-composed-dependencies-differ
vectors.reason: A re-signed Purchase whose commitment also depends on the buyer Vet is not the exact Purchase profile, although its DAG is valid.

vectors.name: awp-completion-delivery-required-roles-empty
vectors.reason: A re-signed Completion whose delivery requires no seller authorization is not the exact Completion profile.

vectors.name: awp-composed-agreement-price-differs-from-listing
vectors.reason: A re-signed Listing whose fixed price differs from the Agreement fails §8.5.2.

vectors.name: awp-composed-agreement-deliverable-hash-differs
vectors.reason: A re-signed Agreement whose deliverable differs from the Listing DeliverableSpec fails §8.5.2.

vectors.name: awp-composed-deadline-exceeds-listing-bound
vectors.reason: An Agreement deadline past the Listing's commitment-relative bound fails at consensus time.

vectors.name: awp-composed-listing-expired-before-commit
vectors.reason: A Listing whose notAfter precedes the authenticated commitment time cannot authorize the session.

vectors.name: awp-sequential-deadline-at-anchor-bound
vectors.reason: Under the sequential gate committedAt is the commitment AnchorReceipt time: an Agreement deadline exactly deadlineSecAfterCommit after it is within the bound.

vectors.name: awp-sequential-deadline-past-anchor-bound
vectors.reason: With the commitment anchored one millisecond earlier the same deadline exceeds the bound, although it is within the bound measured from the later Work receipt.

vectors.name: awp-sequential-listing-not-after-at-anchor-time
vectors.reason: A Listing whose notAfter equals the commitment AnchorReceipt time had not expired at commitment, although it expired before the later Work receipt.

vectors.name: awp-sequential-listing-expired-before-anchor
vectors.reason: A Listing whose notAfter is one millisecond before the commitment AnchorReceipt time expired before commitment.

vectors.name: awp-composed-authorizations-unavailable
vectors.reason: A composed Purchase presented without its operation authorizations lacks role authority; admission is indeterminate and permits no payment.

vectors.name: awp-composed-listing-negotiation-pattern-differs
vectors.reason: An Agreement pattern differing from the Listing pipeline fails §8.5.2.

vectors.name: awp-composed-listing-commit-phase-differs
vectors.reason: An Agreement artifact that mismatches the Listing's commitment phase fails §8.5.2.

vectors.name: awp-composed-agreement-rail-not-accepted
vectors.reason: An Agreement rail that the Listing does not accept fails §8.5.2.

vectors.name: awp-composed-agreement-pins-other-listing-version
vectors.reason: A re-signed Agreement must pin the exact Listing presented.

vectors.name: awp-composed-listing-signed-by-orchestrator
vectors.reason: A Listing validly signed by the orchestrator is not signed by the seller IdentityBundle.

vectors.name: awp-composed-listing-dacs-version-2
vectors.reason: A re-signed Listing with an unsupported dacsVersion is malformed.

vectors.name: awp-composed-two-pay-dem-phases
vectors.reason: A pipeline with two pay-dem phases does not have exactly one Atomic payment.

vectors.name: awp-composed-rail-phase-handler-not-pay-dem
vectors.reason: A network-signed, registry-pinned native-DEM RailDefinition whose phaseHandler is not pay-dem is rejected.

vectors.name: awp-composed-registry-index-version-differs
vectors.reason: A finalized registry index with an unsupported registryVersion is not a pinned snapshot.

vectors.name: awp-composed-registry-index-content-hash-differs
vectors.reason: A finalized registry index that pins another rail content hash does not resolve the presented rail.

vectors.name: awp-composed-payer-bundle-presentation-invalid
vectors.reason: A payer IdentityBundle with an invalid presentation signature is not payer authority.

vectors.name: awp-composed-agreement-discriminator-version-2
vectors.reason: A re-signed Agreement with an unsupported discriminator version is not IdentityBoundPayeeAgreementV1.

vectors.name: awp-composed-payee-bound-agreement-with-current-admission
vectors.reason: A current Atomic payment requires the identity-bound payee agreement, not a legacy payee-bound one, even with a current-profile admission.

vectors.name: awp-composed-commitment-version-2
vectors.reason: A re-signed FinalityCommitmentRecord with an unsupported version is not the commitment artifact.

vectors.name: awp-composed-commitment-subject-other-job
vectors.reason: A re-signed commitment for another jobId does not bind this job, agreement and listing.

vectors.name: awp-composed-vet-record-version-2
vectors.reason: A re-signed Vet record with an unsupported recordVersion is not a CompositeVerificationRecord v1.

vectors.name: awp-composed-vet-record-bundle-hash-differs
vectors.reason: A re-signed Vet record for another IdentityBundle does not vet this party.

vectors.name: awp-composed-vet-record-decision-fail
vectors.reason: A re-signed Vet record whose overallDecision is fail does not establish a pass.

vectors.name: awp-sequential-commitment-receipt-other-content
vectors.reason: A finalized AnchorReceipt for other content does not establish the commitment before signing in sequential mode.

vectors.name: awp-composed-session-context-version-2
vectors.reason: A re-attested session context with contextVersion 2 is not AtomicPaymentSessionContextV1.

vectors.name: awp-composed-session-source-prior-agreement-differs
vectors.reason: A re-attested SessionContext source whose prior agreement hash contradicts the verified Agreement is not DACS authority.

vectors.name: awp-composed-session-evidence-for-other-context
vectors.reason: Session evidence attesting another context hash does not authenticate the presented session context.

vectors.name: awp-composed-payment-input-amount-differs
vectors.reason: An AtomicPaymentPhaseInputV1 amount that differs from the Agreement is not bound to the authenticated parties.

vectors.name: awp-composed-canonical-bytes-over
vectors.reason: A composed Work one byte over the authenticated canonical-byte limit is rejected.

vectors.name: awp-composed-operation-count-over
vectors.reason: A composed Work one operation over the authenticated operation limit is rejected.

vectors.name: awp-composed-limit-metrics-for-other-work
vectors.reason: Network-signed limit metrics for another Work do not measure this one.

vectors.name: awp-composed-reservation-for-other-work

vectors.name: awp-profile-vet-address-consistent-receipt
vectors.reason: A Vet storage operation at another address is rejected under its own consistent receipt.

vectors.name: awp-profile-commitment-address-consistent-receipt
